intro: Lake Creeper Moss is an organic compound harvested from the aquatic creepers dwelling among the Dawning Isles in Lake Lordamere. It serves as a vital reagent sought by the Royal Apothecary Society for their efforts to engineer a lethal new plague.

p: Grown along the hides of the vicious freshwater beasts that prowl the southern Dawning Isles of Lake Lordamere, Lake Creeper Moss carries unique properties shaped by Lordaeron's blighted waters. Apothecary Berard, before Arugal's curse claimed his mind, documented it in his journal, noting that the moss resembled trace materials on the fossils of creatures killed by an ancient plague in the lake. When recovered by Forsaken agents, samples are dispatched directly to the Apothecarium in the Undercity to fuel Master Apothecary Faranell's dark research.
